_meta.note: Hand-transcribed from each chain's public nutrition page (URLs below). Values are per standard serving as listed by the chain. price_hint is a typical Chicago menu price in USD (null = unknown). No scraping. Items marked in `verify` should be spot-checked against the source page before the eval set is finalized.
_meta.verify: See _meta.verification and each chain's `verified` field. Only Sweetgreen is fully official; use other chains as eval ground truth only after re-checking.
_meta.unit: kcal and protein_g per one serving of the named item

verification.note: Per-chain `verified` field carries the detail. Rows with protein_estimated=true have official kcal but estimated protein.
removed: Portillo's: official PDF is Cloudflare-blocked for automated access and for the user; removed rather than keep unverifiable rows labelled as official data

data_status.official: 每一行都逐条对照过官网营养页/官方 PDF/官方 API。代码按官方数据算术,标 official_table + 高置信度,±10%。
data_status.partial: 只抽查过个别行(或 kcal 官方、protein 估算)。代码仍按表算术,但标 reference_table + 中置信度,±15%,不得称'官方数据'。
data_status.unverified: 凭记忆录入,从未对照官网。处理同 partial;核实后再升为 official。
data_status.updated: 2026-10-28: 9 家 unverified + 3 家 partial 不再顶着'官方数据'标签上线(诚实的模糊)。
